annotations.title: Net salary: France vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in France (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in France, in EUR

impat.description: Impatriate regime (recruited from abroad). Flat 30% of pay exempt from income tax for up to 8 years. Default false.

isolated.description: Raising children alone (parent isolé). Unmarried with children living with you: one extra half-part. Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final), 2024 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: France vs the Netherlands
